Class End2DirObjPaths

Return an object that is used to generate the path-tuple (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex) for each path in a railyard where the node of startNodeIndex cntains an end object and the node of endNodeIndex contains a directed object.

isEdge(self, processedNodeIndex, newNodeIndex)

 

A callback function that determines if the edge from processedNodeIndex to newNodeIndex is a valid edge.

An edge is valid by this class if

  • it is considered as a valid edge from DirObj2DirObjPaths and
  • it has the same direction as positive specified in generate.
Parameters:
  • processedNodeIndex - The start node index that connects to the edge to be determined if it is a valid edge.
  • newNodeIndex - The end node index that connects to the edge to be determined if it is a valid edge.
Returns: bool
Return true if the edge contected by processedNodeIndex and newNodeIndex is a valid edge.

generate(self, gType, endFacing=True, positive=None)

 

Iterator over the path-tuples of valid paths in railyard that start from a directed object and end in a node whose degree is 1.

Parameters:
  • gType (Iterable(str) | str) - The user types of the objects starting the valid paths. '*' in gType means all user types.
  • endFacing (bool | none) - If true (false), a path is valid only if the ending object is facing (trailing). An argument of None can be interpreted as "no restriction".
  • positive (none | bool) - If true, the direction of a given edge needs to be positive in order to be considered by the method isEdge as a valid edge. An argument of None is interpreted as "no restriction".
Returns: Iterable(tuple(NodeIndex, tuple(IEdge), NodeIndex))
An iterator returning (startNodeIndex, edgeSequence, endNodeIndex).
